translations.answer: Maintain the hfield geometric dimensions, use 64x32, 32x64, and square resolution for A/B testing; the source code fix is submitted 7b9f5bd. The row span of hfield edge data is changed from nrow to ncol, and a 4x3 non-square hfield regression test is added. Upgrade to the version containing this submission and retest with the user's map resolution.
translations.applicability: Issue MuJoCo 3.3.4 hfield rangefinder/raycast problem; other raycast types need separate validation.
translations.credibility.rationale: The issue has been closed, the environment is clear and there is no conflict. There is formal documentation or precise citation of independent replication.
translations.details.attempts.0: The author provides a minimal runnable code and three resolution comparisons; the maintainer has integrated the code fix and non-square regression test.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Fix the hfield geometric dimensions, swap nrow/ncol resolution for A/B comparison.
translations.details.diagnostics.1: Run the minimal code provided and check rangefinder readings for different resolutions.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Use the MuJoCo version containing submission 7b9f5bdae72480bdbc3b7fd4bef73e6a0925d96e, or verify the equivalent mj_rayHfield index fix.
translations.details.environments.0: MuJoCo 3.3.4; Python API; Ubuntu 24; hfield 64x32, 32x64, and 32x32 comparison.
translations.details.limits.0: The original author did not report a retest after upgrading; the closure is based on the maintainer's confirmation, the fix submission, and the regression test.
translations.details.limits.1: This fix cannot be extrapolated to other sensors or mesh raycasting.
translations.details.outcomes.0: The maintainer confirms the issue is fixed; the submission adds four expected rangefinder values for a 4x3 hfield.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Why does MuJoCo's rangefinder give incorrect edge measurements on non-square hfields? How can we confirm the fix?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Use the target map resolution for replaying perception tests before and after the upgrade to avoid directly using incorrect terrain distance in real-world foothold calculations.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The fix submission indicates that the hfield edge height data index was incorrectly using nrow, and for non-square resolutions, the row span should be ncol.
translations.details.symptoms.0: When the geometric dimensions are unchanged, the rangefinder on non-square resolution incorrectly hits the hfield edge; the 32x32 square resolution gives the expected result.
translations.source.title: MuJoCo 3.3.4 Non-Square hfield Rangefinder Mismeasurement Fixed by Raycast Index
translations.title: How Should We Locate and Fix the Non-Square hfield Rangefinder Mismeasurement in MuJoCo 3.3.4?
